svg.title: CareProof
svg.desc: CareProof turns the paperwork of unpaid caregiving into a CareScore out of 1000, a rupee valuation and a portfolio. The ring shows how the 1000 points split: 400 for responsibility, 350 for consistency, 250 for complexity. Winner of the Lovable x Anthropic Buildathon, March 2026.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Turns hospital notes, school reports and bills
into a CareScore out of 1000, a rupee value
and a portfolio for lenders and employers.
Won the Lovable × Anthropic Buildathon, March 2026
